topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can’t shake the unease since I heard the news. My favorite place, the one with the warm lights and the comfy booths in the corner, the spot where time felt as light as the fluffy bread they served, is going to close. It’s like losing a piece of home. Every time I pass by, I can’t help but look through the windows, as if hoping it’s all just a misunderstanding. I keep thinking about all the times I spent there, sipping coffee that tasted just right, and wondering where I’ll go now, if I’ll ever find that kind of comfort again.
